description_sq:
Shitet Apartament 2+1 tek Farmacia 10 me siperfaqe ndertimi 97m2 bruto,84m2 neto me hipoteke, ne katin 6 te nje pallati te ri me ashensor. 
Prona ka orientim me diell dhe nje organizim teper funksional: 2 dhoma gjumi, soallon,kuzhine ,koridor shperndares te te gjitha dhomave, tualet dhe ballkon me dalje nga dhoma.
Specifikat e prones: Apartamenti eshte totalisht i sapo investuar meparket, sistem kapot, termoizolim,hidrosanitare incaso, dritare plastik me xhama triplo.
Apartamenti shitet i mobiluar si ne foto.
Cmimi i shitjes 245.000euro
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale at Farmacia 10 with a construction area of ​​97m2 gross, 84m2 net with mortgage, on the 6th floor of a new building with an elevator. The property has a sunny orientation and a very functional organization: 2 bedrooms, living room, kitchen, distribution corridor to all rooms, toilet and balcony with exit from the room. Property specifications: The apartment is completely newly invested with parquet, hood system, thermal insulation, incaso sanitary ware, plastic windows with triple glazing. The apartment is sold furnished as in the photo. Selling price 245,000 euros
